subject: POC next steps & RACI — EvergreenHealth trial
messages:
From: Dr. Emily Turner <e.turner@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <r.singh@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood POC trial — initial follow-up

Hi Marissa / Laura —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Good discussion. I wanted to capture the immediate asks and clarify success criteria so we can align internally before the kickoff.

Recap / asks from our side:
- Primary goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for patient triage summarization (abbrev. accuracy + latency).
- Success criteria (what we'll use to sign off):
  - Accuracy: summary ROUGE-L improvement over our baseline by at least 12% on the 500-case holdout set.
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for 512-token prompt under our test load (50 concurrent).
  - Cost target: projected $/1k tokens under $7 for steady-state.
  - Data handling: must support VPC/private deployment or isolated dataset (audit logs required).
- Timeline: target 4-week POC starting as soon as infra/network access is ready.

Questions to clarify ownership so we can map internal RACI:
1) Who will host the model for the trial — Redwood hosted or Evergreen infra?
2) Who owns sample data delivery and anonymization steps?
3) Who is our security contact for questionnaire and connectivity?
4) Procurement: are there any PO or contract requirements before we start?

I've attached a short doc with our internal requirements (Evergreen_POC_requirements.pdf). Can you please propose owners for each area and a draft timeline?

Thanks,
Emily Turner
Director, Clinical Innovation
Evergreen Health

----
Attachment: Evergreen_POC_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Emily Turner <e.turner@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC trial — initial follow-up

Emily —

Great to meet you yesterday — appreciate the clear criteria. Below is a proposed POC plan and a preliminary RACI that we can iterate on.

Proposed POC summary (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): network access + sample data delivery, sign SOW
- Week 1: model onboarding + baseline comparison using a synthetic subset
- Week 2: run scaled load tests (50 concurrent), measure latency / throughput
- Week 3: evaluation on holdout set, quality measurements (ROUGE, clinical review)
- Week 4: final analysis, cost projection, signoff or next steps

Draft RACI (high level) — please confirm or propose alternatives:
- Redwood: Model hosting + inferencing runtime (Responsible), test harness and load generator (Responsible), evaluation scripts (Responsible)
- Evergreen IT / Infra: Provide VPC peering / network ACLs and sample data access (Accountable)
- Evergreen Security: Answer security questionnaire, confirm encryption/KMS requirements (Accountable)
- Evergreen Procurement: Sign SOW / PO (Accountable)
- Clinical SME at Evergreen: Provide labeling/acceptance criteria (Consulted)

Next steps (asks from Redwood):
1) Please confirm the Evergreen owner for "Infra / network" and "Security" (names & emails) so we can add them to the kickoff invite.
2) Sign the attached RACI workbook (evergreen_poc_raci.xlsx) with any edits.
3) Let us know procurement timelines / PO lead.

We'll scope Redwood to run the model in our hosted environment for the POC by default (this shortens time-to-evaluate). If you'd prefer a private deploy we can switch but that adds ~1 week for network and KMS setup.

Attaching: evergreen_poc_raci.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains a row-level RACI I'll pre-fill with the suggested owners above.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once owners are confirmed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: evergreen_poc_raci.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Emily Turner <e.turner@evergreenhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC trial — initial follow-up

Emily / Marissa —

Quick ops notes from my side on ownership and what we'll need to hit the latency target:
- Hosting: Redwood can host the POC in our dedicated hosted sandbox. We'll be Responsible for model runtime, autoscaling config, and KV/prefix caching.
- Evergreen infra: will need to provide either a secure S3 endpoint with sample data or allow our sandbox to pull data over an authenticated connection. For private deploy option, Evergreen's infra team must provision a VPC peering connection and open the following egress: 443 to api.redwoodinference.com and SSH (22) only if we need remote debug.
- Security: need confirmation on allowed data types (PHI allowed only if covered by BAA) and KMS key access if you prefer encryption with your keys.
- Test harness: Redwood will supply the load generator and synthetic traffic config. For the 50 concurrent scenario we recommend a 2-GPU baseline instance for stress tests.

I've attached a small network config template that lists required CIDRs and example IAM policy to speed things up.

Happy to jump on a short ops call with your infra/security folks.

-Aditya

----
